channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Zach LaVine | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Zach LaVine from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Scott Perry on Zach LaVine
item.description:
“We have a very good relationship and good understanding. Zach is still an excellent basketball player. He knows what’s expected of him. He’s coming back here this year. I’m very clear with him on that. He’ll be the first to tell you that. “And I think he’s ready to come back and embrace that and perform to the best of his abilities this year. We can use a lot of the things that Zach LaVine is able to do on the basketball field, so I’m looking forward to him taking a step forward with us this year and how we want to play the game.”

Scott Perry on Zach LaVine, Jul 9, 2026. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Julius Randle on DeMar DeRozan, Zach LaVine, Ayo Dosunmu
item.description:
‪Michael Scotto‬:Julius Randle on Ayo Dosunmu:

“I didn't know he was that damn good. I ain't gonna lie to you. When I was in the East and he was in Chicago, that were those DeMar DeRozan and Zach LaVine teams, so I don’t know if the opportunity was there as much, but damn, I'm glad we got him.”

Julius Randle on DeMar DeRozan, Zach LaVine, Ayo Dosunmu, Apr 26, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Josh Giddey on Zach LaVine
item.description:
“With Zach [LaVine] being traded... not to say Zach was hindering anybody... [but] he was such a big part of what we did, [so] it opened up an avenue for me to step into a bigger role when he was traded. I tried to take that with both hands.”

Josh Giddey on Zach LaVine, Oct 1, 2025. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Coby White on Zach LaVine
item.description:
Coby White on Zach LaVine trade:

“Myinitial reaction was sadness. He’s always had my back no matter what.”

Coby White on Zach LaVine, Feb 4, 2025. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Patrick Williams on DeMar DeRozan, Garrett Temple, Nikola Vucevic, Zach LaVine
item.description:
“You’re coming in and you’re asked to do more. That’s with any job on the planet. When they pay you a little bit more, you’re asked to do a little bit more. For me it’s kind of walking in and leaning into it.“They’ve asked me to be more of a leader. I’ve been able to see how guys — obviously DeMar [DeRozan] — seen how he led. With Zach [LaVine], see how Vooch [Nikola Vucevic] leads. Early on it was Thad Young, Garrett Temple, you see the way they led. You pick up little things from them knowing that, and hoping that my time will come to lead, and that time has come. It’s a challenge for sure, something new, but I always try and lean into it.”

Patrick Williams on DeMar DeRozan, Garrett Temple, Nikola Vucevic, Zach LaVine, Oct 5, 2024. Source: Chicago Sun-Times.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Zach LaVine
item.description:
Billy Donovan on Zach LaVine fitting in while trying to develop young players:

“We have a lot of players who need the ball in their hands.”

Billy Donovan on Zach LaVine, Sep 30, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Zach LaVine
item.description:
“Him and Zach [LaVine] are No. 2 and they can stay there, hopefully. That record will be broken, records are meant to be broken, so I’m going to enjoy it while I got it, but it’s going to be broken one day. I just hope they put an asterisk next to mine, like, ‘did it in 27 minutes.’”

Klay Thompson on Zach LaVine, Apr 9, 2024. Source: San Francisco Chronicle.

item.title: Lonzo Ball on Zach LaVine
item.description:
Lonzo Ball on Zach LaVine's injury:

“You look at the big picture. ... I think it’s gonna make him a better human. He’s gonna come back and do his thing for sure. I’m not worried about that.”

Lonzo Ball on Zach LaVine, Feb 3, 2024. Source: Twitter @byjuliapoe.

item.title: Jeff Coby on Zach LaVine
item.description:
KC Johnson:Coby on chemistry with LaVine:

“We don’t have egos where it’s like, ‘I want the ball.’We want to win. Whoever has it going, it is what it is. He’s not selfish enough to come and say,‘Yo, give me the ball.’ He’s a winner. He's going to do what’s best for team. And for me, it's same”

Jeff Coby on Zach LaVine, Jan 10, 2024. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Zach LaVine
item.description:
Donovan on LaVine:

“He sees what these guys have done and how they’ve played. His mindset is he wants to enhance it and contribute. And I think the skill set that he has, he should fit in fine to that. My biggest thing for him has been the quick decisions.”

Billy Donovan on Zach LaVine, Jan 5, 2024. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Zach LaVine
item.description:
Julia Poe:Billy Donovan on whether Zach LaVine has ever told him he’s out on the Bulls:

“No. He’s never, ever once said that to me at any point in time.”

Billy Donovan on Zach LaVine, Nov 15, 2023. Source: Twitter @byjuliapoe.

item.title: Torrey Craig on DeMar DeRozan, Zach LaVine
item.description:
“Everybody knows two of the most talented scorers on the team with LaVine and DeRozan. Once those guys get it going, it’s pretty much a wrap. As a defender, I can give those guys tips and advice on what teams want to do and how they want to guard them and the insight I had playing against those guys to give them any edge they need.”

Torrey Craig on DeMar DeRozan, Zach LaVine, Aug 21, 2023. Source: NBC Sports Chicago.

item.title: DeMar DeRozan on Zach LaVine
item.description:
Rudy Gobert, who picked up his 6th foul guarding DeMar DeRozan, on DeRozan and Zach LaVine's shot-making tonight:

“Those two guys were making a lot of tough shots tonight. Got a little help, of course. As usual. But they made a lot of tough shots”

DeMar DeRozan on Zach LaVine, Mar 18, 2023. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Patrick Williams on DeMar DeRozan, Zach LaVine, Kevin Durant
item.description:
Patrick Williams on matching up with Kevin Durant tonight:

“I definitely enjoy it. ... I always want to be able to look back and say I battled with KD, I battled with LeBron, I was playing on a team with DeMar DeRozan and Zach LaVine. You never know how much longer they have.”

Patrick Williams on DeMar DeRozan, Zach LaVine, Kevin Durant, Jan 4, 2023. Source: Twitter @byjuliapoe.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Zach LaVine
item.description:
“Now, that is a possibility—Davis is a Chicago guy and if he were going to leave the Lakers, the Bulls would be one of the few places he’d be OK with. The Bulls and the Lakers would be swapping stars with injury problems, essentially. LaVine (who is 27) is younger than Davis, so that is an advantage but at full health, Davis (29) is a much, much better player.”

Anthony Davis on Zach LaVine, Dec 23, 2022. Source: Heavy.com.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Zach LaVine
item.description:
Bulls coach Billy Donovan said.

“And I thought that was the best decision at the time. To me, I don't look at it as anything else but the one-off game where this is what was going on. I know he wanted to be out there. There's probably not very many games in his career where [LaVine] hasn't been out there in those moments, but that group was playing well and it gave us a chance.”

Billy Donovan on Zach LaVine, Nov 19, 2022. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Arturas Karnisovas on Zach LaVine
item.description:
KC Johnson:Artūras Karnišovas on Zach LaVine:

“We've been very open that we hope Zach is here for a long time. Nothing has changed.”

Arturas Karnisovas on Zach LaVine, Jun 27, 2022. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Dalen Terry on DeMar DeRozan, Zach LaVine
item.description:
Dalen Terry:

“I watched so much DeMar DeRozan this year... Zach LaVine, smoothest player ever.”

Dalen Terry on DeMar DeRozan, Zach LaVine, Jun 23, 2022. Source: Twitter @rob_schaef.

item.title: Marc Eversley on Zach LaVine
item.description:
Marc Eversley on Zach LaVine's impending free agency:

“It's our every intention to bring him back. We're excited about the opportunity to sit down and talk with him, we think he'll be excited for the opportunity to sit down with us.”

Marc Eversley on Zach LaVine, Jun 23, 2022. Source: Twitter @rob_schaef.

item.title: LaVar Ball on Zach LaVine
item.description:
“Okay, it started off Zach LaVine, Zach LaVine, Zach LaVine. Okay, now you get hurt, a few things happen, and guess who’s doing all the big plays? All I hear is DeMar. DeMar, DeMar, DeMar. He don’t want to play second fiddle, and who don’t want to go to L.A.? He want to go back to the West Coast.”

LaVar Ball on Zach LaVine, May 19, 2022. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Arturas Karnisovas on Zach LaVine
item.description:
Julia Poe:Artūras Karnišovas on Zach LaVine as he enters free agency:

“He knows exactly what to expect here. We have a really good relationship with him. And the last two years have been best years of his career.”

Arturas Karnisovas on Zach LaVine, Apr 29, 2022. Source: Twitter @byjuliapoe.

item.title: DeMar DeRozan on Zach LaVine
item.description:
KC Johnson:DeMar DeRozan on Zach LaVine:

“As bad as I know he wants to play, he’s gotta take care of his body.”

DeMar DeRozan on Zach LaVine, Feb 14, 2022. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Zach LaVine
item.description:
Rob Schaefer:Billy Donovan on the Zach LaVine update from today:

“Very optimistic and very grateful it wasn’t something more… I don’t think it’s something that’s long-term, which is a good thing.”

Billy Donovan on Zach LaVine, Jan 15, 2022. Source: Twitter @rob_schaef.

item.title: Michael Reinsdorf on Arturas Karnisovas, Zach LaVine
item.description:
“Arturas and Billy really took the time to get to know Zach LaVine, and knew that he wanted to win,”

Michael Reinsdorf on Arturas Karnisovas, Zach LaVine, Jan 14, 2022. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Zach LaVine
item.description:
Billy Donovan on Zach LaVine playing through fever:

“Physically, you could tell he was sick. His eyes were all bloodshot. I give him a lot of credit.”

Billy Donovan on Zach LaVine, Nov 30, 2021. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: DeMar DeRozan on Zach LaVine
item.description:
DeMar DeRozan on Zach LaVine and Bulls’ unselfish mentality:

“He was trying to force me to get 40 tonight and I told him I was tired.”

DeMar DeRozan on Zach LaVine, Nov 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Draymond Green on Zach LaVine
item.description:
“He (LaVine) had no clue. He had no idea about anything when it came to wine. And it was good just to see him start trying wine. Before you knew it, Zach was coming up to the lounge, like ‘Hey, man, we drinking some wine tonight?’”

Draymond Green on Zach LaVine, Nov 13, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Zach LaVine
item.description:
USA Basketball coachGregg Popovich on Zach LaVine:

“He's somebody who really wanted to do this. His physical skills are abundant and obvious.. . . He's willing to do anything we ask him to do.”

Gregg Popovich on Zach LaVine, Jul 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Jerry Colangelo on Zach LaVine
item.description:
KC Johnson:USA Basketball men's national team managing director Jerry Colangelo on Zach LaVine's Olympic selection:

“He almost jumped through the phone he was so excited about the opportunity. And I love that.”

Jerry Colangelo on Zach LaVine, Jun 28, 2021. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Arturas Karnisovas on Zach LaVine
item.description:
Arturas Karnisovas on Zach LaVine's extension eligibility:

“Everything is going to go day-by-day. Obviously, we’re looking forward to talking to Zach in the future.”

Arturas Karnisovas on Zach LaVine, May 17, 2021. Source: Twitter @rob_schaef.
